W25 Monday.recipe_context: This week's recipe: Harissa Chickpea Feta Cups (breakfast). These savory North African–inspired cups bake chickpeas, roasted peppers, and spinach into a softly set egg base with pockets of salty feta and smoky harissa heat. Each round, golden portion pops out of the tin as a complete protein-packed bite that reheats beautifully for weekday breakfasts or light lunches.

W38 Wednesday.recipe_context: This week's recipe: Cardamom Cinnamon Spiral Bites (sweet). These spiral bites wrap classic cinnamon-roll comfort around warm cardamom, orange, and pistachio for a Middle Eastern–inspired twist. A rich, buttery dough is coiled into each muffin cup so it bakes into a round, self-contained roll with crisp edges, tender centers, and a glossy orange-rose glaze.
